bolt11_pay.note: Decodes lnbc invoice, pays via LND routerSendPaymentV2

bolt11_receive.note: Receive screen creates invoices via LND addInvoice

bolt12_pay.note: Parser only accepts lnurl/lnbc/lntb; LND 0.21.3 lacks BOLT12 offers

bolt12_receive.note: Only BOLT11 invoices; no offer code in app or LND

offline_receive.note: Lightning Box is Android-only; iOS has only local notifications, no push-woken receive

lnurl.note: pay, withdraw, channel and auth all supported

ln_address_pay.note: 'Send to Lightning Address' menu item, LUD-16 resolution

ln_address_receive.note: Lightning Box address menu/settings gated to Android only

bip353.note: user@domain resolved only via .well-known/lnurlp; no DNS lookup

mpp.note: MPP on by default (maxParts 16), toggle in settings

keysend.note: Keysend screen under drawer 'show more'; accept-keysend=1 for receiving

choose_peer.note: Open channel to any pubkey@host; also autopilot (Blixt node) and Dunder LSP

jit_channels.note: Dunder LSP opens channel on receive; on by default (README checkbox outdated)

splicing.note: No splice RPC in LND 0.21.3; nothing in app

anchors.note: Channel open refuses peers without anchor support (feature bit 23)

local_pathfinding.note: Embedded LND routes from local graph; speedloader gossip sync on by default

watchtower.note: LND wtclient exists but app config/UI never enables it

channel_backup.note: SCB exported to iCloud (auto) and restorable at wallet restore

taproot.note: Default receive address is P2TR; long-press for P2WPKH

multisig.note: Single-sig LND wallet only; no multisig/shared account code

hw_signer.note: LND has PSBT/remote signer; app has no PSBT or signer code

coin_control.note: App sendCoins passes no outpoints; LND supports outpoint selection

tor.note: Experimental toggle on iOS; embedded Tor via react-native-nitro-tor
